```sql
with fx as (
    select c.rate_date,
           c.currency,
           cast(c.usd_per_unit / r.usd_per_unit as decimal(38,12)) as to_reporting
    from fx_rates c
    join fx_rates r on r.rate_date = c.rate_date and r.currency = 'INR'
),
captures_all as (
    select ci.name as city_name,
           a.amount_minor,
           a.currency,
           a.business_date,
           row_number() over (
               partition by a.order_id, a.amount_minor
               order by a.attempt_no, a.attempt_id
           ) as capture_rank
    from payment_attempts a
    join orders o on o.order_id = a.order_id
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    join cities ci on ci.city_id = s.city_id
    where a.status = 'captured'
      and not a.is_test
      and not o.is_test
      and s.region_id = 'IN-TN'
),
city_months as (
    select c.city_name,
           sum(case
                   when c.business_date between date '2026-07-01' and date '2026-07-31'
                   then c.amount_minor * fx.to_reporting
                   else 0
               end) as july_gmv,
           sum(case
                   when c.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-31'
                   then c.amount_minor * fx.to_reporting
                   else 0
               end) as august_gmv
    from captures_all c
    join fx on fx.currency = c.currency and fx.rate_date = c.business_date
    where c.capture_rank = 1
      and c.business_date between date '2026-07-01' and date '2026-08-31'
    group by c.city_name
)
select city_name as key,
       cast(round(august_gmv - july_gmv) as bigint) as value
from city_months
where august_gmv > july_gmv
order by value desc, key asc
```
